# Glossolalia Explorer

> A public collection of glossolalia transcriptions, proposed interpretations, and contextual materials supplied by the site's author.

This guide points to public sources and their context. The linked Markdown versions preserve the original Russian content. Translations and dictionary readings are proposed interpretations, with their source and status recorded in the materials. An analysis label such as "100%" expresses the author's assessment; it does not establish independent verification of a transcription or translation.

Relative links within verbatim Markdown copies refer to the original repository paths. Each source card links to the original file on GitHub.

## Start here

- [For AI (Markdown)](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/for-ai/index.md): Entry point with dated source cards for texts addressed to AI and links to public materials.
- [For AI (HTML)](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/for-ai/): Browser version of the same section.
- [Translation prompt (HTML)](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/translation/): Translation instructions, links to the current dictionaries, and related document cards.
- [Proposed word dictionary (HTML)](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/dictionaries/words/): Primary page for words and proposed meanings, with the methodology above the dictionary.
- [Word dictionary (Markdown)](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/dictionaries/words.md): Canonical word entries and their sources.
- [Word dictionary methodology (Markdown)](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/dictionaries/methodology.md): The author's supplied method for finding and classifying candidate readings.
- [Suffix and particle dictionary (HTML)](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/dictionaries/suffixes-and-particles/): Primary page for suffixes and particles, with their methodology and context.
- [Suffix and particle dictionary (Markdown)](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/dictionaries/suffixes.md): Canonical suffix and particle entries and examples.
- [Suffix and particle methodology (Markdown)](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/dictionaries/suffix-methodology.md): Supplied method and confidence notes.
- [Channel abbreviations (HTML)](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/articles/channel-abbreviations/): Primary page for abbreviations and full short words, retaining their contexts and reading statuses.
- [Channel abbreviations (TXT table)](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/data/dictionary_of_abbreviations.txt): Canonical abbreviation table included in the prompt archive.

## Public content

- [All transcription analyses](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/transcription-analyses/): Grouped links to individual analyses and distinct historical versions; labels use receipt dates or source group and part.
- [Home](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/): Site overview and navigation.
- [Transcription calendar](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/calendar/): Dated transcription cards and their source context.
- [Situations](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/situations/): Thematic pages with transcriptions and accompanying interpretations.
- [Help and background](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/help/): Explanations, author materials, and collected articles.

## Site indexes

- [Content manifest](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/content-manifest.json): Source-file hashes for comparing published content with the repository.
- [Sitemap](https://glossalia-explorer.tuqo.ru/sitemap.xml): Public page URLs.
